description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguage class, a filter field used in reporting to filter employees based on their language skills. It extends functionality for adding language-based filters to database queries, converting language IDs to display labels, and integrating with the language service.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguage
classes.description: A filter field class for filtering employees based on their language skills in reports. Implements methods to modify query builders and convert language IDs to human-readable labels.

methods.name: addWhereToQueryBuilder
methods.description: Adds a WHERE clause to the query builder to filter by employee language if the operator is EQUAL and the value is not null.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns the alias used for the language entity in queries.

methods.name: toArrayXValue
methods.description: Converts the language ID to an associative array containing its ID and name, or null if not found.
